title: Chapter 353 Rescue
content:
Chapter 353 Rescue

On the battlefield located in the center of the two armies, with the addition of 10,000 cannon fodder from the coalition forces, the precarious front of the coalition forces was stabilized and regained the upper hand.

"My lord, the enemy has begun to send reinforcements again."

A person dressed as a lieutenant standing beside Tomita Yoshinari couldn't help asking when he saw tens of thousands of reinforcements emerging from the opposite side.

"Mr. Xiaolin, don't worry, the matter has not reached this point yet."

Tomita Yoshinari smiled, and didn't mean to send reinforcements to support the battlefield immediately.

"But general, if we don't send reinforcements up, our troops may not be able to sustain it, and it is very likely that we will fall into defeat."

Mr. Xiao Lin was full of anxiety. Looking at the battlefield, his troops were getting smaller and smaller, and the originally wide front was shrinking, so he couldn't help but feel extremely worried.

"Although that's the case, Mr. Xiaolin found out that there is a change on the battlefield."

Tomita Yoshinari's face is calm, and the worries about his future have disappeared. Instead, there is a sense of victory, and the demeanor that everything is in the palm of his hand, which makes people secretly heartbroken.

"Variety?"

Infected by his own general, Mr. Xiao Lin, who was a little anxious, gradually calmed down, but he still had some doubts.

"That's right, change. Mr. Xiaolin noticed that without this battlefield, although our army is retreating steadily and the defense line is shrinking. But the concentration of troops makes the defense more stable. It is extremely difficult for the enemy to break through. , to pay an unbearable price.”

After hearing the words, Mr. Xiao Lin carefully observed the battlefield again and found that it was so.

Although the defense line of the own camp below has shrunk, but because there are too few places to defend, the troops are more concentrated and the defense is more stable.

The enemy often wants to open a gap, and they have to pay several times the price, and they are quickly pushed out by the reserve team that has long been waiting, and the gap is re-sealed.

And after such a long time, Mr. Xiaolin also found that the faces of every enemy soldier below inevitably showed signs of exhaustion. Many people were panting and sweating profusely.

Even if they had just joined the battlefield not long ago, many of the 5,000 new reinforcements sent by the enemy were breathing heavily, obviously exhausting their physical strength.

It is not without benefits to have a high cultivation base. Military generals like Mr. Xiaolin have superb cultivation bases and have reached the fourth-order state.

And as Kobayashi-kun's main general, that is, the man Tomita Yoshinari, his strength is as high as the fifth level, and he has reached the peak of all the cultivation worlds in the world, and his strength is unfathomable.

According to Mr. Xiaolin's guess, he himself has already reached the fourth level of cultivation, and he is still a relatively strong group in the fourth level.

Facing the attacks of the enemies on the opposite side, he could kill five or six hundred people alone. This is also because the opposite is in the army, and there are many practitioners among the generals, and their strength is not weak.

Otherwise, if it is just ordinary people without any internal strength cultivation, Mr. Xiaolin himself can even kill more than 3,000 people before dying of exhaustion.

And Tomita Yoshinari, a man who is like a god and demon in the eyes of Mr. Xiaolin, is estimated to be able to kill more than 3,000 people, or even five or six thousand people when facing the siege of the opposite army alone. To be able to know all too well.

In this world full of gods and demons, personal superpowers are so powerful that it is easy for a powerful master to wipe out cities and countries.

Of course, no master will do this, because there are some hidden masters in any country.

If you really wantonly slaughtered creatures regardless of any scruples, it will definitely cause everyone to attack, and even the best masters will not be able to stop them.

However, these thoughts were just in Mr. Xiao Lin's mind, and then he left them behind and continued to pay attention to the situation on the battlefield.

With the development of the war, the situation on my side became more and more unfavorable. The defense line that was originally shrunk to a few points was shrinking, and the gaps left between the defenders gradually became crowded. Even the mobilization of troops was difficult. Some difficulty.

The most important thing is that there were originally more than 7,000 of our own troops on the battlefield. With the continuous encirclement and suppression of the opposing coalition forces, the number has dropped to more than 3,000, more than half lost.

If it weren't for the fact that these troops were surrounded by the codes given by the coalition forces, leaving them no retreat or way out, they looked like they were going to die, and all their vitality was completely wiped out.

In addition, not far from them are the camps of the army everywhere, there are a full 30,000 troops on the scene waiting for the battle, with sufficient backup and a glimmer of hope, these people have already completely collapsed and surrendered or fled.

"My lord, the situation is not optimistic!"

Mr. Xiaolin sighed, if he doesn't support now, his own troops in the central battlefield will be wiped out.

Of course Mr. Xiaolin would not feel distressed by the death of such ordinary soldiers, because there are still many such soldiers in the army here, and even the more elite second-tier soldiers have not been dispatched yet.

What really made him feel helpless was that if these soldiers were wiped out continuously, the morale of the coalition forces on the opposite side would rise sharply, and the morale of the army on his side would also drop sharply.

This kind of morale increase and increase is crucial for an army.

An army with high morale, even if it is a rabble, can defeat a regular army that has been trained for a long time and has been honed on the battlefield, as long as it has a sufficient numerical advantage regardless of damage.

As for an army with low morale, no matter how well-trained it is and how many victories it has fought, if the spirit in its heart is gone, it will become a weak lamb and be ravaged by others.

"It's not optimistic. It's not enough. But it's time to send troops to support. If the fight continues, it will be detrimental to the morale of the army."

Mr. Xiaolin was overjoyed when he heard the sound, and couldn't help but look away from the battlefield, looking at Tomita Yoshinari beside him.

I saw Tomita Yoshinari looking down from the high podium with the same eyes, but his eyes were not on the battlefield, but on the opposite coalition camp.

This gaze is deep, and there seems to be infinite mystery in it, which makes people unable to look directly at it.

"grown ups?"

Kobayashi-kun spoke out. He just looked at Tomita Yoshinari as if he wanted to send troops to rescue him, but he said, but there was no movement or order. He just stared blankly at the motionless coalition camp on the opposite side.

This time, Mr. Xiaolin couldn't help being anxious, so he reminded him aloud.
